controls.title: Information Security Policies & Leadership
controls.evidence: Published in /.well-known/security.txt, SECURITY.md, and formal trust portal.

controls.title: Incident Notification & Vulnerability Disclosure SLA
controls.evidence: Guaranteed < 1 hour P1 critical response via security@ritualdev.in and GHSA advisories.

controls.title: Continuous SAST & Threat Modeling
controls.evidence: CodeQL AST inspection active across all 25 repositories with 0 open vulnerabilities.

controls.title: Cryptographic Signing & Software Bill of Materials (SBOM)
controls.evidence: Sigstore cosign SLSA 3 provenance and CycloneDX/SPDX SBOMs attached to every release.

controls.title: Zero-Bypass Branch Protection & Privilege Isolation
controls.evidence: GitHub branch protection enforce_admins: true; synthetic surrogate token masking.

controls.title: Kernel Sandboxing & Zero-Egress Network Isolation
controls.evidence: Bubblewrap, Seatbelt, and AppContainer syscall isolation; AGENTSHIELD_AIR_GAPPED=1 verified.

controls.title: Mandatory Peer Reviews & Reproducible Pinned Builds
controls.evidence: 100% PR review requirement; all GitHub Actions pinned to 40-character commit hashes.

controls.title: Zero Data Custody & Air-Gapped Local Processing
controls.evidence: Zero customer telemetry ingestion; runs 100% locally on workstation or inside private VPC.
